main_text.p: tatis. Species enim mulierum, eloquium; gestus, & ornatus, & quicquid in eis est, flamma est, ideoque speciem mulieris alienæ multi admirati, reprobi facti sunt. Colloquium enim illius quasi ignis exardescit. Nihil autem tutius & sanctius, quàm matrimonium colere. Sicut autem de vestimento genera-tur tinea ad eius corruptionem: sic ex mulie-re iniquitas mulieris: sic enim quidam legunt: vel ex muliere extranea viro accidit, sicut licet affectuum malitia & carnis iniquitas, dum aspectu, affatu, tactu, & cohabitatione viri ad libidinem excitantur, & mulieris nutibus capiuntur. Mulier enim viri precio-sam animam capit, & iniquitatis ream con-stituit, vel sola aspectu. Nunquid enim homo potest abscondere ignem in sinu suo, ut vestimenta illius non ardeant? Unde recte Germani, Das strow vom fewz/so brens nit. Weit[?] Darnon/ ist gut fürs gesch[?]. Igitur A-lexander Magnus, quum Darij filias haberet captiuas, demissis oculis eas salutabat, idque raro, sibi metuens ab illarum infigni forma. Idem quum apud Antipatridem cœ-naret, isque ad cœnam formosam psaltriam induxisset, aspectu motus in illam exarsit; mox rogavit Antipatridem, nunquid ipse mulieris amore teneretur, illo confitente, o scefte, inquit, non tu protinus abduces è conuiuio mulierem? Ita Cyrus abstinebat à confpectu Pantheæ[?]: & Arafpo dicenti, mulierem esse infigni forma, dignam regis ocu-lis

page.notes: Lines 1 to 2 of the text are cut off at the left by a page edge, so the start is a fragment; the paragraph continues from the previous page. The German phrases are in black letter (Fraktur) and are doubtful: "Das strow vom fewz/so brens nit" is uncertain; "Weit Darnon/ ist gut fürs gesch..." is largely unreadable in the scan and was not reconstructed. "scefte" is read from "scelefte" and is doubtful, possibly "scelerate". "Pantheæ" is uncertain. The mark "è" after "abduces" is doubtful. The hyphen in "mulie-re" at the line end is not clearly visible. No footnotes or marginal notes are printed on this page. Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
